title: Pointed evaluation coprojection equation
statement: The canonical colimit evaluation map composed with every strict henselization cone leg equals the chosen geometric point of the corresponding affine pointed neighbourhood.

proof.text: Use colimit.ι_desc for the evaluation cocone; apply Spec.map_comp, the ΓSpecIso triangle, and toSpecΓ_naturality; cancel the affine isoSpec with its inverse.
